page.overview:
Who is Crimson Guard Commander?

Crimson Guard Commanders are the Cobra Officers of the Crimson Guard organization. Crimson Guard Squad Leaders operates as cell leaders when in deep cover, and as low-ranking officers on the field. Much like a real terrorist cell leader, a Crimson Guard Squad Leader relays orders from the higher ups, to the common "Siegies" who have penetrated deep into normal society. Crimson Guard Commanders (AKA: Crimson Guard Officers) command a larger body of Guardsmen (possibly, a whole series - like the "Fred" series). These higher ranking Siegies are the closest to Cobra Commander, and work directly under him. Gaining rank in Crimson Guard Command is based on archiving political and economic power.

Xamot and Tomax are the highest ranking Crimson Guard Commanders.
